start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-one-piece-of-content-from-audience-to-publish with my purpose record, the goal 'show a new baker how to learn the morning bake in one shift', for a YouTube Short, using my own records."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Have your purpose record (your statement and the tests it names), your technique, principle and format rows, and your footage indexes in your own lists.
2. Say "Run workflow:make-one-piece-of-content-from-audience-to-publish" with purpose, goal, destinations and records.
3. Work through the steps in order (read-records, audience, idea, filmed-points, format, titles-and-hooks, pretest, script); never skip ahead to the edit.
4. At check-words fix every failing line, then film the shoot sheet, and approve the cut when the person-sees step shows it.
5. After publish, read the numbers at 1, 7 and 28 days in the learn step.
